blind.description: A stylized wooden A-frame chalkboard/easel. It features four splayed legs with horizontal bracing crossbars holding a dark grey chalkboard slate. On one side, the frame includes a small tray/ledge holding a red duster/eraser and two sticks of white chalk. Both sides feature faded white chalk diagrams (alchemical or chemical formula diagrams). The textures are stylized hand-painted wood grain and slate.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as an elongated rectangular horizontal wooden top bar with four splayed leg ends visible below, and a tray shelf holding a red eraser and white chalk sticks.
blind.height_vs_figure: About two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3.5 to 4 feet tall), and roughly 3 feet wide.
